lessons_used: Evidence is still thin to establish rules for [adoption, new_screen], [finish, new_flow], [finish, new_screen], [sign_in, notification], and [sign_in, reorder] since each kind of change has only one test so far.
Evidence for [adoption, new_flow] remains mixed: one test won (+7.6% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (-1.6% after noise correction).
Evidence for [adoption, redesign] remains inconclusive: one test was stopped early (-8.4% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (+0.8% after noise correction).
[finish, redesign] changes tend to be helpful, as two tests won (+5.5% and +4.3% after noise correction).
Predictions were consistently too low for winning tests across all rounds.
Predictions were usually too high for tests that stopped early or showed no clear effect, with round 11 as the sole exception.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Docking and Visibility Control Center
candidates.change: Rebuild the home intro screen into a split control hub featuring interactive pet desktop visibility toggles and display position settings.
candidates.why: Three support tickets reported pets not displaying on the desktop post-setup, and previous finish step redesigns consistently won (+5.5% and +4.3%).

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Control your pet's desktop overlay position, visibility toggles, and screen behavior right here before starting.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro overlay with layout and component changes is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step redesigns consistently win (+5.5%, +4.3%) and address reported pet visibility issues.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Crafting Studio Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the photo upload stage into a full-bleed interactive studio layout with dynamic photo positioning guidelines.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (69.7%) and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals.

upload_photos.headline: Design Your Custom Desktop Pet
upload_photos.body: Upload photos to generate your custom pet avatar with full photo framing tools.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload screen while retaining its core function is permitted.

candidates.score_note: High impact area, but adoption redesigns have historically been negative or inconclusive (-3.1% avg).

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Control and Voice Practice Sequence
candidates.change: Insert a multi-screen interactive practice flow after home intro teaching desktop shortcuts, hiding the pet, and voice commands.
candidates.why: Three support emails noted confusion over controlling, hiding, or interacting with the pet after onboarding.

new_controls_flow.headline: Learn Companion Shortcuts
new_controls_flow.body: Try hiding your pet with Alt+H or calling them back with Alt+C.

guard.reason: Adding new interactive tutorial screens after home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High lift potential (+10% in prior single test), but high implementation cost and thin evidence.

candidates.title: Persistent Pet Sync Sign-In Layout
candidates.change: Update the sign-in layout to split format with clear cloud sync indicators assuring users that pet data persists across sessions.
candidates.why: Eight support tickets—the largest issue group—reported pets disappearing or resetting after logging back in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In & Cloud Save Your Pet
sign_in.body: Your companion and custom traits will be safely synced to your account so you never lose your progress.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in screen layout and adding sync indicators is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets the largest support complaint group (8 tickets) at sign-in step.

candidates.title: Desktop Render Stage Progress Tracker
candidates.change: Display an active rendering progress status timer and informative setup tips while waiting for pet generation.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high mean duration (2336s) and median (201s), causing drop-off during background pet asset compilation.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: We are preparing high-res sprite animations and system tray integration.

components.text: Did you know? You can drag your pet anywhere on your desktop screen once ready.

guard.reason: Adding progress indicators and tips to the waiting screen during pet generation is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses major waiting drop-off duration (mean 2336s) at low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Pet Companion Orientation Showcase Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated orientation screen before path selection highlighting everyday desktop pet activities.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path despite taking only a median of 8s, indicating a lack of context on companion capabilities.

new_lifestyle_orientation.headline: Meet Your Desktop Workmate
new_lifestyle_orientation.body: Desktop pets react to your work breaks, play idle animations, and stay by your side all day.

guard.reason: Adding a new orientation screen before path selection is permitted within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen to a fast 8s step adds friction without support mail justification.

candidates.title: Pet Selection Compatibility Hints
candidates.change: Add clear helper hints on pet choices detailing rendering requirements and personality traits.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 69.7% conversion rate and 3 support complaints regarding poor custom pet generation results.

pick_friend.hint: Tip: Standard pets launch instantly on all screens; custom photo pets require clear lighting.

components.text: Select a companion style below to preview desktop behavior.

guard.reason: Adding helper hints to the pet pick screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost config change targeting adoption, the lowest conversion step (69.7%).

candidates.title: Desktop Active Taskbar Status Banner
candidates.change: Update the home intro text to explicitly state that the app runs minimized in the system tray if no pet appears immediately.
candidates.why: Three support tickets reported users being unable to open the app or missing the pet on their desktop after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Pet Successfully Placed on Desktop!
home_intro.body: If your pet is hidden, check your system tray/taskbar icon or press Ctrl+Shift+P to reveal it instantly.
home_intro.hint: Click the taskbar pet icon anytime to open companion settings.

guard.reason: Updating text copy on home_intro to explain taskbar functionality is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy update addressing user confusion on taskbar status post-onboarding.

candidates.title: Path Choice Starter Companion Perk Highlight
candidates.change: Incorporate a featured starter bonus badge onto path choice options to increase path completion rates.
candidates.why: Nearly 24% of users drop off on choose_path, so an immediate value incentive improves completion.

guard.reason: Rule 3 prohibits onboarding copy from mentioning prices, discounts, gifts, or free extras; 'Includes Free Starter Accessories' violates this.

candidates.title: Account Auth Sync Protection Notice
candidates.change: Display a prominent sync confirmation banner on the sign-in screen informing users their pet profile is auto-backed up.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back into their account.

guard.reason: Adding a cloud save badge and notification setting to the sign-in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Quick banner fix targeting the top support ticket complaint (8 emails) at sign-in.
